title: US Dollar Index, USD/CAD, AUD/CAD Analysis: CA inflation, BOC on tap
text: With the BOC on alert for higher inflation, with key CPI metrics already curling higher, USD/CAD traders will keep a close eye on the latest CPI figures to drop on Tuesday. The US dollar index and USD/CAD also look set for at least a small bounce over the near term.

title: AUDCAD Wave Analysis
text: AUDCAD recently reversed down from the resistance zone between the resistance level 0.8860 (former support from August and January), 20-day moving average and the 61.8% Fibonacci correction of the downward impulse 1 from March.
